```{r}
#| message: false

# install.packages(tidyverse)
# install.packages("dplyr")
# install.packages("knitr")
# install.packages("tinytable")
# install.packages("readr")

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tinytable)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Read in raw data 

raw_data <- read.csv("Commute_Data_Database.csv")

raw_data
```

```{r}
# Renaming columns that will not be dropped in next step 

commute_relabeled_cols <- raw_data |>
  rename(
    Geography = GEO, 
    Gender = Gender..3., 
    Mode = Main.mode.of.commuting..11A., 
    Immigrant_Status = Immigrant.status.and.period.of.immigration..11., 
    Count = VALUE
  )

names(commute_relabeled_cols) # Confirming renaming worked as planned
```
```{r}
# Setting which modes of transportation will be kept in this dataset 
# Filtering out "Driver with 1 or more workers", "Passenger with 2 or more
# workers", and "Sustainable transportation" as these include duplicates 
# with the modes kept

modes_keep <- c("Car, truck or van", "Public transit", "Active transportation", 
                "Other method")

# Filtering out unecessary columns to keep and ensuring that the "Immigrant 
# Status" column does not include duplicates by only looking at "Total -
# Immigrant status and period of immigration"
commute_clean <- commute_relabeled_cols |> 
  filter(
    Immigrant_Status == "Total - Immigrant status and period of immigration", 
    Mode %in% modes_keep
  ) |> 
  select(Geography, Gender, Mode, Count)

# Test to ensure that output is correct 
# (Should be 13 provinces x 2 genders x 4 modes of transportation)
stopifnot(nrow(commute_clean) == 104) 
```

```{r}
commute_clean <- commute_clean |> 
  mutate(Count = as.integer(Count))

commute_clean
```

```{r}
commute_clean <- commute_clean |> 
  arrange(Geography, Gender, Mode)

commute_clean
```

```{r}
# Test to ensure "Count" = integer column & does not include negative values
stopifnot(
  "Count must be an integer column" = is.integer(commute_clean$Count),
  "Count has negative values"       = all(commute_clean$Count >= 0)
)

# Test to ensure there are no missing values in dataset
stopifnot("Data contains missing values" = !anyNA(commute_clean))

# Test to ensure there is no blank text strings in dataset
stopifnot(
  "Blank text found" = all(
    commute_clean |> 
      select(where(is.character)) |> 
      map_lgl(\(x) all(str_trim(x) !=""))
  )
)
```

```{r}
write_csv(commute_clean, "Cleaned_Commute.csv")
```
